tiers.entry_criteria: Issue reported via intake form, chat, or email
tiers.escalate_when: Not resolved within 4h, or root cause unknown
tiers.handles: Password resets, how-to questions, known issues with documented fixes
tiers.name: Tier 1 — Help Desk

tiers.entry_criteria: Tier 1 attempted documented fix; issue reproduced
tiers.escalate_when: Requires a code change, data fix, or vendor involvement
tiers.handles: Configuration errors, data mismatches, workflow bugs with a workaround
tiers.name: Tier 2 — Product Ops

tiers.entry_criteria: Tier 2 confirmed a defect or platform-level failure
tiers.escalate_when: — (top tier; unresolved Sev-1 pages the on-call director)
tiers.name: Tier 3 — Platform Engineering
